properties.name: displayType
properties.label: Display Type
properties.description: How to display the looked-up value

properties.name: sourceFieldId
properties.label: Source Field ID
properties.description: The ID of the field to watch — a SelectBox (pick a key) or a TextField (type a key). A SelectBox triggers the lookup on change. A TextField triggers it on change, on blur, and while typing after a short pause, so the looked-up value appears without leaving the field.

properties.name: lookupFormId
properties.label: Lookup Form ID
properties.description: The Joget form definition ID to fetch the record from (e.g., 'customerForm', 'assetMasterForm').

properties.name: lookupColumn
properties.label: Lookup Column
properties.description: The column name to extract from the fetched record (e.g., 'displayName', 'ticker', 'isin').

properties.name: lookupKeyColumn
properties.label: Lookup Key Column
properties.description: The column in the lookup form that matches the watched field's value. For example, if the SelectBox uses idColumn='customerId', or the TextField holds a TIN, set this to 'customerId' / 'tin'. Leave empty to use the Joget primary key (only works when the watched value IS the record ID).

properties.name: updateOn
properties.label: Update On
properties.description: When to trigger the lookup. A TextField source ALWAYS also triggers on blur and on debounced typing, whichever is chosen here.

properties.name: inputDebounceMs
properties.label: Typing Debounce (ms)
properties.description: TextField sources only: how long to wait after the last keystroke before looking up. Default 400.

properties.name: notFoundMessage
properties.label: Not-found Message
properties.description: Shown when the watched key matched no record. The value is CLEARED in that case — a key that resolves to nothing never keeps the previous record's value.
